title: Estonia's Defence Scandal and Austerity Squeeze Test Government Credibility · 12 Sep
keywords: Estonia, defence procurement, ammunition scandal, ministerial resignation, fiscal austerity, NATO, Ukraine support, Baltic states, public finances, defence spending, European security, government accountability
notes: A failed ammunition procurement deal has triggered ministerial resignations and a widening trust crisis in Estonia's defence institutions, arriving at the worst possible moment for a government already struggling to balance fiscal discipline with rising security costs. The scandal raises pointed questions about oversight and due diligence in fast-moving wartime procurement. Together with a tight budget environment, the episode illustrates the pressures facing small frontline NATO states as they attempt to support Ukraine while keeping public finances and public confidence intact.
